item.title: Public Defender’s Office awarded state grant funding
item.description: The Solano County Public Defender’s Office announced on Monday that it has been awarded $440,601 through the Expanded Public Defense Grant (Holistic Defense), administered by the California Office of the State Public Defender. This grant is part of a statewide initiative to strengthen public defense services and promote equitable access to justice. The grant period runs from February through May 2028. item.title: 49ers defensive end Keion White shot in ankle in San Francisco, team says
